title: P3 operators as interfaces to ET vehicles
summary: Steven Greer tells of P3 operators as interfaces to ET vehicles, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Jake talked about, Jake Barber talked about who are these P3 operators go through a rigorous training program so they can become like almost like a machine human machine interface between the people controlling them and the ET vehicles.

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who says UFO secrets are held by a hidden global group, told podcast host Jesse Michels about something a man named Jake Barber described. According to Greer, Barber spoke of people called P3 operators who go through hard training so they can act almost like a link between human and machine, connecting the people who control them to alien vehicles. If true, it would mean humans are being trained to help steer craft from other worlds.
